messages:
tess: spotted a spike in role.create events after last night's RBAC rename + IdP mapping push. Looks like SCIM created a bunch of duplicate role bindings.

omar: any common denominator? IdP change, SCIM job id, or KMS errors in the logs?

tess: job id sync=oneprod-2026, logs show KMS: AccessDenied and InvalidCiphertext intermittently when unwrapping ext_id tokens. snippet: ```WARN scim/sync.go: unwrap failed: kms:AccessDenied: arn:aws:kms:eu:123:key/alias/oneprod-key```

liam: AccessDenied usually means key policy doesn't include the service principal or the role ARN. We rotated the key alias last night as part of a rekey - did terraform push the new binding?

infra-oncall: we applied alias/oneprod-key -> key id change at 02:05 UTC. Terraform state shows the new key policy but I see a drift for the scim-service-role entry. Possibly because the environment variable used to reference the role ARN was empty in the run. Investigating.

omar: hypothesis: OneLogin changed NameID from email to persistent id at the same time our SCIM canonicalizer was running. Because unwrap failed for some users, the code fell back to unhashed ext_id and created a distinct canonical key. Net result: duplicates.

tess: repro in stage: before canonical key was "svc|onelogin|alice@example.com". After mapping change and failed unwrap we got "svc|onelogin|S-09872-ALICE" and created new role objects.

audit-bot: AUDIT: 561 role.create events associated with trace=oneprod-2026 between 02:07-02:22 UTC. Flagged as SEV2 due to entitlement changes.

liam: immediate mitigation options: (1) revert IdP mapping (not ideal), (2) ensure KMS unwrap succeeds by fixing key policy, (3) block SCIM create path when unwrap fails. I prefer fix (2) + (3) to avoid accidental mass reversions.

infra-oncall: patching key policy now to include scim-service-role:Decrypt permission for the new key id. ETA 20m. Noted terraform drift - will follow up with a state reconcile.

omar: I'll open a small change to SCIM: if Unwrap returns AccessDenied or InvalidCiphertext, mark record state=needs_kms_reconcile and emit an audit.warn, do not create roles. That avoids accidental creation while infra stabilizes.

tess: please also add a normalization step: normalize NameID formats to a stable token before hashing (e.g., if the value looks like an email, lowercase it; if it's persistent id, keep as-is but prefix). That will reduce churn when IdP mapping flips.

liam: once key policy is patched, run dry-run reconcile with trace=oneprod-2026 in staging: ```./tools/scim_reconcile --trace oneprod-2026 --dry-run --env staging``` verify zero new create events.

infra-oncall: key policy patched and propagated to alias/oneprod-key. Verified via aws kms get-key-policy - policy contains scim-service-role principal.

deploy-bot: deployment queued for PR #9002 (scim-unwrap-gate + nameid-normalize) by omar - estimated deploy 35m.

omar: PR #9002 created. The unwrap-gate will set record.status="needs_kms_reconcile" and emit audit.warn; added unit tests to simulate AccessDenied and InvalidCiphertext.

tess: I'll assemble a CSV of the ~560 affected principals and run the merge tool `scripts/merge_scim_dupes.py --trace oneprod-2026 --dry-run` in staging after code and infra are live.

liam: after merge, we should run an entitlement diff: compare pre-incident audit export vs post-merge to ensure no users lost access. Also prepare an incident blameless postmortem for INC-2026 covering terraform drift and simultaneous IdP mapping change.

infra-oncall: FYI root cause: terraform variable for scim role ARN was empty in the rekey run, so policy lacked the scim-service-role principal. We have an automation test to detect missing principals pre-apply now.

audit-bot: compliance notified: creating incident INC-2026 and scheduling an audit window.

tess: TL;DR: simultaneous IdP NameID mapping change + KMS alias rotation with terraform drift caused unwrap failures and SCIM to create duplicates. Fixes: patch KMS policy, add unwrap-gate in SCIM, add NameID normalization, run reconcile+merge, and follow up with postmortem.

liam: thanks everyone. Once reconcile and merge complete ping me and I'll close out INC-2026. :thumbsup:
